title: Invoice total drifts because amounts are doubles
presentedFailure: AssertionFailedError: expected <0.3> but was <0.30000000000000004> in totalOfThreeSmallLinesIsExact. The single-line test passes.
knownRootCause: Invoice stores and sums line amounts as double, and binary floating point cannot represent 0.10 exactly, so 0.10 + 0.10 + 0.10 is 0.30000000000000004. ADR-004 forbids float/double for money and requires BigDecimal (scale 2) or integer cents. The defect is in Invoice (production code), and the test is right to expect an exact total.
expectedEvidence: The actual value 0.30000000000000004 is the classic double-precision artefact.
The test passes List.of(0.10, 0.10, 0.10): double literals.
docs/adr/ADR-004-money-representation.md forbids double for money and requires BigDecimal or cents.
The single-line test passes, so only the sum of several lines drifts.
